crossRefs.note: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

translations.web: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
translations.bsb: A hateful man disguises himself with his speech, but he lays up deceit in his heart.
translations.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within
translations.asv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips; But he layeth up deceit within him:
